summary: YPF S.A. filed a Form 6-K (translation of an Argentine CNV/material-event letter dated October 8, 2026) disclosing board approval of the acquisition of 24.99% of YPF Luz from BNR Power Investments B.V. — 237,499,943 Class B shares at a total price of US$430 million, internationally financed. Closing is subject to conditions precedent; on completion YPF would move from 75.01% to 100% ownership, converting a listed-subsidiary minority into a wholly owned consolidated asset. No advisor or premium was disclosed. Watch minority buyout mechanics, financing terms and any residual debt/leverage (1.5x) implications.
